watch_outs: Home Improvement Contractor Registration: Massachusetts requires HIC registration for contractors Massachusetts Home Improvement Contractor (HIC) registration is required—verify at mass.gov. Contractors must also carry insurance. Reddit users emphasize checking that the registration is current.

High Construction Costs: Boston area has among the highest construction costs nationally Labor costs in Greater Boston are 40-50% above national average. Reddit warns that very low bids often mean unlicensed workers or shortcuts. Get multiple bids but be realistic about pricing.

Lead Paint in Older Homes: Massachusetts has extensive pre-1978 housing with lead paint Massachusetts has strict lead paint laws, especially for rental properties. EPA RRP rules apply, and Massachusetts has additional requirements. Reddit strongly recommends testing and certified contractors.

Asbestos Concerns: Asbestos is common in older Massachusetts homes Older homes often have asbestos in insulation, floor tiles, and siding. Reddit recommends testing before renovation. Professional abatement is required—DIY removal is illegal.

Ice Dams & Winter Damage: Massachusetts winters cause significant ice dam and freeze damage Ice dams cause major interior damage. Reddit strongly recommends proper attic insulation and ventilation, plus ice/water shield extending well past the eaves. Heated cables are a band-aid, not a fix.
